# Unit test for function median
def test_median():
    # Odd-length list
    assert median([3, 1, 2]) == 2
    assert median([10, 20, 30, 40, 50]) == 30

    # Even-length list (average of two middle elements)
    assert median([1, 2, 3, 4]) == 2.5
    assert median([10, 2]) == 6.0

    # Single element
    assert median([5]) == 5

    # Unsorted input should be handled
    assert median([9, 1, 5, 3, 7]) == 5
    assert median([4, 1, 3, 2]) == 2.5

    # Negative numbers
    assert median([-1, -5, -3]) == -3
    assert median([-10, 10]) == 0.0

    # Floats
    assert median([1.5, 2.5, 3.5]) == 2.5
    assert abs(median([1.1, 2.2, 3.3, 4.4]) - 2.75) < 1e-9

    # Duplicates
    assert median([2, 2, 2, 2]) == 2.0
    assert median([1, 2, 2, 3]) == 2.0

    # Original list should not be mutated by sorting
    data = [3, 1, 2]
    median(data)
    assert data == [3, 1, 2]

    print("All median tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_median()
